what: This line sorts a slice of service objects based on their hostnames.
why: Initially, this sorting was added to accommodate Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Services (MCS) which needed distinct host and VIP configurations for each cluster [1][2]. The code suggests this was intended as a foundation for future features like IPv6 support, which necessitates multiple cluster VIPs [2][3].
